test.query: SELECT count() FROM (SELECT if(number % 100000 = 0, NULL, number)::Nullable(UInt64) AS a FROM numbers_mt(10000000)) AS l JOIN (SELECT if(number % 100000 = 0, NULL, number)::Nullable(UInt64) AS a FROM numbers_mt(10000000)) AS r ON l.a <=> r.a

SELECT count() FROM (SELECT if(number % 100000 = 0, NULL, number)::Nullable(UInt64) AS a, if(number % 3 = 0, NULL, number % 5)::Nullable(UInt8) AS b FROM numbers_mt(10000000)) AS l SEMI LEFT JOIN (SELECT if(number % 100000 = 0, NULL, number)::Nullable(UInt64) AS a, if(number % 3 = 0, NULL, number % 5)::Nullable(UInt8) AS b FROM numbers_mt(10000000)) AS r ON l.a <=> r.a AND l.b <=> r.b
